name: Delivery page filter controls are usable in Dev environment
description:
Objective: Delivery page filter controls are usable in configured environment.
Preconditions: Open Notification portal dev env with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Notification portal dev env.
2. Delivery page filter controls are usable in configured environment.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: After configured app login, delivery filter controls (event type, recipient, status, Refresh) must all be accessible.
